title: chant template request
description: A request for an app, or an add-on to an app, made from one version of a template in a release catalog, version 1 of its contract. A product turns it into a pull request on the branch requestBranch names, with requestBody as the body; the body carries this document in a fenced block whose info string is `json` and this schema's id, so a reader recovers it from the pull request alone. checkTemplateRequest refuses a request against the catalog and the version's template.yml (template.schema.json). Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version.

kind.description: app: a new app. addon: an add-on to the app named in `app`, which must exist.

template.description: The template's address, such as `acme/bucket/aws` (namespace, name, system). The branch uses its name: the second-to-last segment of an address with three or more, else the last.

version.description: The version in the catalog, or its digest for a release that names no version.

app.description: The app's name: a lowercase letter, then up to 39 lowercase letters, digits and -.

addon.description: For kind addon: the add-on's name, with the same rule as `app`.

inputs.description: The values given, by input name. An input left out takes its default. A sensitive input is never here.

requestedBy.description: Who asked, as the forge vouches for it: the login of the run's actor, a person or the identity an agent runs as.

claimedBy.description: The person the client says filled the form or asked the agent, when it names one. The forge does not vouch for it, so a reader shows it as claimed, next to requestedBy.

via.description: Where the request came from: a form, an agent over MCP, or the command line.
